chunks: Whatever is in it from Abū al-Numayr, the mawlā of al-Ḥārith ibn al-Mughīrah al-Naḍrī, I have narrated from Ḥamzah ibn Muḥammad al-ʿAlawī—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Abū al-Numayr.

key_terms.الْعَلَوِيِّ: An attribution indicating descent or affiliation to the line of ʿAlī عليه السلام.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal expression of narration by the compiler.
key_terms.مَوْلَى الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ الن: The client/freedman affiliation identifying Abū al-Numayr.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū al-Numayr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the compiler transmits reports from Abū al-Numayr. It serves as a chain-authentication notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the route of transmission rather than presenting a substantive hadith teaching.
